fusions.name: Snagged Thread
fusions.desc: Casts a hooked tine on a thread that deals 4 damage, with a 35% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Frayed to Nothing
fusions.desc: Cards the tines through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances and leaving each enemy [Exposed] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Carded Batting
fusions.desc: Wraps you in combed padding that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Rag-Bag Dressing
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
